summary: Completed testing of Create Receptionist Flow, Receptionist Login, Receptionist Access Restrictions, and Data Isolation between doctors. Fixed a critical bug where the create_receptionist endpoint required unnecessary 'role' field - created a new ReceptionistCreate model for simpler API. All 12 backend tests and 4 frontend E2E tests passed.
passed_tests: Test 1: Admin can create receptionist via Settings > Clinic tab
Test 1: Doctor can create receptionist via Settings > Clinic tab
Test 1: Unauthenticated users cannot create receptionist
Test 2: Newly created receptionist can login
Test 3: Receptionist gets empty prescriptions list
Test 3: Receptionist gets empty certificates list
Test 3: Receptionist can see all patients list
Test 3: Receptionist can see all appointments
Test 3: Receptionist patient profile only shows Profile, Labs & Imaging, Attachments tabs (Visits and Documents hidden)
Test 4: Doctor cannot see other doctors' patients via /api/patients
Test 4: Doctor gets 404 when trying to access another doctor's patient directly
Test 4: Doctor can see their own patients

bugs_fixed.issue: Used uuid4() instead of uuid.uuid4() - NameError
create_receptionist endpoint required 'role' field from UserCreate model even though role is auto-set to 'receptionist'
bugs_fixed.fix: Created new ReceptionistCreate model with only email, full_name, password fields

critical_code_review_comments: ReceptionistCreate model added for cleaner API - only requires email, full_name, password
Role-based access control properly enforced in backend for visits/prescriptions/certificates
Frontend correctly hides Visits and Documents tabs for receptionist role
Data isolation between doctors working correctly - patients have owner_id field
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test receptionist accounts and doctor accounts during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Receptionist creation, login, and access restrictions thoroughly tested. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_receptionist_and_isolation.py cover all 4 scenarios. Receptionist can only see Profile, Labs & Imaging, and Attachments tabs on patient profile - Visits and Documents are hidden. Data isolation between doctors working correctly - each doctor only sees their own patients.

uuid4_bug.root_cause: Missing uuid. prefix when calling uuid4() at line 362
uuid4_bug.reproduction: Creating a receptionist would fail with NameError: name 'uuid4' is not defined

role_required_bug.root_cause: create_receptionist endpoint used UserCreate model which inherits from UserBase, requiring 'role' field even though the endpoint automatically sets role='receptionist'
role_required_bug.reproduction: Frontend form only sends email, full_name, password - backend returns 422 'Field required' for missing 'role'
role_required_bug.mitigation: Created new ReceptionistCreate pydantic model with only required fields (email, full_name, password)
